items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Well, he played with you, didn't he, kora?

ctx.x: I sing on piano and, uh, kora, on trumpet. Kora? Kora. Original kora.
Oh, yeah. Original kora. Yeah. And, uh, yeah. Well, he played with you, didn't he, kora?
Yes, he did. Mm-hmm. I played the harmony a long time. Mm-hmm. Yeah. I understand they have a very much band down there, too.
